title: Mechanically vented and direct-vented appliances: when make-up air is needed in a dwelling unit
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023; printing not stated in document; CSA B149.1 natural gas and propane code cited in the coderefs (not in package)
document_date: Date Issued: March 2026 (platform created March 30, 2026, last updated April 2, 2026)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies which appliances meet the NBC(AE) definitions of mechanically vented and direct-vented, and when make-up air is needed in a dwelling unit to protect against depressurization.
Dwelling units with fuel-fired space-heating or water-heating appliances do not require make-up air if the appliances are mechanically vented or direct-vented as defined in NBC(AE).
Category III and IV appliances are less sensitive to depressurization than Category I and II appliances.
Systems referred to as forced draft, power vented or induced draft may be covered by the mechanically vented definition.
